policy: Copied first-party palette controls add bounded group learning only within the three already existing alternate RGBA8 palette orders, with each prior order floor and optional LIMIT recovery. Full original 8/16-bit RGB/RGBA samples, including hidden RGB, must survive native/Rust decoding across single/multiple groups. Both the current qualified managed peak and the eight original pre-learning peaks must succeed with complete size floors. Original-bound baseline bytes must reproduce the original independently exact control; lower effort keeps identical bytes and ordinary lossless options omit the separately guarded lossy-only progressive field. Owned storage and all input/source/module/harness/tool/report identities remain pinned. Production is unchanged and there is no speed claim.
